transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess I'm just having some trouble with things at work lately. We got a new operations manager, and... he's been picking apart the inspection procedures I've used for years. 

I just... I can't seem to leave it at work anymore. I come home all wound up, and I end up snapping at my husband. Then I just lie awake replaying the meetings in my head. It's... well, it's making me second-guess routine quality calls the next day. Things I used to do without any trouble. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself worrying about work-related issues even when you're not at work, like during the evening or early morning?
Yeah... like I said, I just kind of lie awake thinking about those meetings. So... yes. Mostly in the evenings. It's just hard to shut it off.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms, like headaches, stomach issues, or muscle tension, when you're feeling stressed about work?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, maybe a little tense sometimes, but... nothing like that. Just tired, mostly.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with family?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I still do my usual things. I'm just... tired, I guess. But no, not really.
Have you noticed yourself getting more irritable or frustrated than usual, even about small things?

I suppose... maybe a little. I just come home pretty wound up lately, and... well, I guess I've snapped at my husband a few times. It's just... we got this new operations manager, and he keeps picking apart the inspection procedures I've used for years. I just can't seem to leave work at work anymore. And then the next day, I end up... I don't know, second-guessing routine quality calls I used to make without any trouble.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or on edge about work situations even when you're away from work, like worrying something bad might happen?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I replay the inspections in my head, like I said, but... I'm not sitting at home scared that something terrible is going to happen. Just... mostly just frustrated, I guess.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about whether your work is good enough or if something might go wrong with the inspections, even when there's no immediate problem?

I wouldn't say I worry constantly, no. I know my work is good. I've done it for years. It's just... like I said, I just replay what he picks apart. But I'm not... I don't sit there worrying about things going wrong out of nowhere.
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep because your mind keeps going over work issues, even when you want to rest?
Yes... sometimes. I just... I do lie awake replaying those meetings with him. It's... hard to shut it off when I'm just trying to rest.
Have you found that you don't enjoy the things you used to, like hobbies or time with people you care about?
No, not really. I still do my usual things. It's just the work stuff that bothers me.
Do you feel unusually fatigued or low on energy, even when you haven't had a particularly stressful day at work?
No, I wouldn't say that. I'm... I mean, I'm tired sometimes, sure, but just the normal amount. It's not anything unusual.
Do you find that you feel anxious or worried about work-related issues on most days, even when there isn't an immediate problem or deadline?
No, not really. If there's no actual problem going on... I don't just sit around worrying about it. It's really just... what I mentioned before.
Do you feel like you have trouble controlling your thoughts about work, even when you want to focus on something else?
No, I wouldn't say that. Once I leave the floor for the day... I can usually just leave it there. I don't really sit around dwelling on it.
Do you find yourself feeling worried or anxious about your performance at work, even when you know you're doing things correctly?
No, not really. I know how to do my job. If I'm doing it right, I don't... I don't see any reason to be anxious about it.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things at work, even when you know the criticism might not be entirely your fault?
No. I mean... if I make a mistake, I'll admit it. But if it's not my fault, I'm not going to sit around feeling guilty about it.
Do you find it hard to relax or unwind in the evenings or on days off because your mind keeps going back to work stressors, like the new manager or the changes to procedures?

Well, I guess... yeah, lately. Ever since the new operations manager started picking apart the inspection procedures I've used for years. I just... I can't seem to leave work at work anymore. I come home all wound up, and I end up snapping at my husband. And then at night, I just lie awake replaying the meetings. It's frustrating because the next day, I end up second-guessing routine quality calls that I used to make without any trouble.
Do you feel anxious specifically during or after interactions with the new operations manager, or when thinking about his criticism of your procedures?
Yeah, I suppose I do. It's just... tense, when he's around. Or when I know I have to talk to him.
Do you feel anxious specifically before or during interactions with the new operations manager, like your heart races or you feel shaky inside?
No... not really. I don't get shaky or anything like that. My heart doesn't race. It's just... like I said before. Just tense.
Do you feel anxious or worried specifically about your job performance or the changes at work, even when you know things are under control?
I don't really know... I guess if I know things are actually under control, I'm okay. I haven't really noticed worrying then.
